TRAFFIC ADVISORY

In connection with the “Run for Unity” on the occasion of the 150th Birth Anniversary of Late Shri Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, traffic restrictions and diversions will be in place on 22.11.2025 (08:30 AM – 12:00 Noon) to ensure smooth movement.

📍 EVENT ROUTE
DDA Sports Complex, Maya Muni Ram Marg → MCD Parking, Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Commercial Complex, near Road No. 44, Pitampura
Approx. 2000 participants are expected to join the event.

📍 TRAFFIC RESTRICTIONS / DIVERSIONS (On Need Basis)
-Commuters are advised to avoid the following roads between 08:30 AM and 12:00 Noon:
•Maya Muni Ram Marg
•Lala Jagat Narain Marg
•Road No. 44, Pitampura
•M2K Road
-No heavy vehicles will be permitted on these stretches during the event.
📍 ADVISORY TO MOTORISTS
-Follow the directions of traffic police at diversion points
-Avoid restricted roads and plan journeys in advance
-Use alternate routes to prevent delays
📍 PARKING & GENERAL VEHICLE INSTRUCTIONS
-Park only at designated parking areas
-No roadside parking permitted on Maya Muni Ram Marg, Lala Jagat Narain Marg & Road No. 44, Pitampura
-Vehicles parked illegally will be towed and prosecuted as per law
📍 PUBLIC INSTRUCTIONS
-Avoid unnecessary travel near the event route
-Report any unattended object or suspicious activity to the Police immediately
📍Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police channels.

#DPTrafficAdvisory

📍 KPHB Traffic PS – Traffic Update

Traffic movement is currently slow at JNTU from Forum Mall Road due to peak-hour congestion.

 Traffic staff are monitoring the location and working to streamline vehicle flow at the earliest.
